pages.text: A wall screen that reads a network.

pages.title: Setup
pages.text: Mount it on a sturdy wall and link it with the Binder. Open it empty-handed.$(br2)It has no settings and no battery.

pages.title: Reading
pages.text: $(li)State: Normal, Battery backup, Brownout, No power, Not linked$(li)Supply and demand, kW$(li)Battery charge, kJ$(li)Machines waiting for power, by name

pages.title: Comparator
pages.text: Output follows battery charge: 0 when empty, up to 15 when full.
Iron, copper, glass panes and redstone.
